trap.why_en: 0 is position 4 (remainder 0). Position 50 has remainder 2 → digit 5.

hint_steps_en: The digits cycle with period 4: pos 1=3, pos 2=5, pos 3=8, pos 4=0.
50 ÷ 4 = 12 remainder 2.
Remainder 2 → position 2 in the cycle → digit 5.
The answer is 5, which is B.

Each rabbit has 2 extra legs over a chicken.

params.aria_id: Mengasumsikan semua ayam memberi 52 kaki; 28 ekstra dibagi 2 menghasilkan 14 kelinci.

trap.why_en: 8 = 4 flights × 2 min, but floor 1 to floor 6 has 5 flights, not 4.

hint_steps_en: Floor 1 to floor 3 = 2 flights of stairs = 4 minutes → 2 min per flight.
Floor 1 to floor 6 = 5 flights (count the steps between floors, not floor numbers).
Time = 5 × 2 = 10 minutes.
The answer is 10, which is C.
hint_steps_id: Lantai 1 ke lantai 3 = 2 tangga = 4 menit → 2 menit per tangga.
Lantai 1 ke lantai 6 = 5 tangga (hitung tangga antar lantai, bukan nomor lantai).

items.text_en: B (8 min) = 4 flights — floor 1 to 6 is 5 flights ✗
items.text_id: B (8 menit) = 4 tangga — lantai 1 ke 6 adalah 5 tangga ✗

params.aria_en: Two flights take 4 minutes so 2 minutes per flight; five flights to floor 6 take 10 minutes.
params.aria_id: Dua tangga membutuhkan 4 menit sehingga 2 menit per tangga; lima tangga ke lantai 6 membutuhkan 10 menit.

highlights.note_en: Repeating cycle of 5: sum per cycle = 1+3+5+7+8=24
highlights.note_id: Siklus berulang 5 suku: jumlah per siklus = 1+3+5+7+8=24

highlights.phrase_en: Find the sum of the first 48 numbers

highlights.note_en: 48 = 9 full cycles + 3 extra terms
highlights.note_id: 48 = 9 siklus penuh + 3 suku ekstra

strategy.name_en: Cycle sum × quotient + remainder terms
strategy.name_id: Jumlah siklus × hasil bagi + suku sisa

trap.why_en: 48÷5=9 r3, not 10. Always compute the remainder.

hint_steps_en: Cycle: 1,3,5,7,8 (period 5). Sum per cycle = 24.
48 ÷ 5 = 9 remainder 3.
9 full cycles: 9×24=216.
Extra 3 terms (1,3,5): sum=9.

params.intro_en: Find the cycle sum, multiply, then add the leftover terms.
params.intro_id: Cari jumlah siklus, kalikan, lalu tambahkan suku sisa.
params.final_en: The sum of the first 48 numbers is 225.
params.aria_en: One cycle sums to 24; 9 full cycles give 216; three extra terms add 9; total is 225.
params.aria_id: Satu siklus berjumlah 24; 9 siklus penuh memberi 216; tiga suku ekstra menambahkan 9; totalnya 225.

trap.why_en: Today is day 1 (Tuesday). Day 100 is 99 days later. 99 mod 7 = 1, not 100 mod 7 = 2.
trap.why_id: Hari ini adalah hari ke-1 (Selasa). Hari ke-100 adalah 99 hari kemudian. 99 mod 7 = 1, bukan 100 mod 7 = 2.

hint_steps_en: Today is Tuesday (day 1). Day 100 is 99 days after today.
99 ÷ 7 = 14 remainder 1.
Remainder 1 = 1 day after Tuesday = Wednesday.
The answer is Wednesday.
hint_steps_id: Hari ini adalah Selasa (hari ke-1). Hari ke-100 adalah 99 hari setelah hari ini.

params.aria_en: Day 100 is 99 days after Tuesday; 99 mod 7 equals 1; one day after Tuesday is Wednesday.
params.aria_id: Hari ke-100 adalah 99 hari setelah Selasa; 99 mod 7 sama dengan 1; satu hari setelah Selasa adalah Rabu.
